lines.text: The LORD's new song is to be sung from the ends of the earth, and the people of Sela sing from the mountaintops.
The villages of Midian are told to cry aloud, and the LORD goes forth like a warrior.
The LORD says He will groan like a woman in labor and lead the blind by a way they did not know.
Those who trust in idols will be turned back in shame, and God asks who is blind like His servant.
The Philistines gave Jacob up for spoil, because the people would not walk in His ways.
